ratios.quote: Total Net Leverage Ratio not to exceed 2.75 x as of each fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2026 through and including December 31, 2026
Asset Coverage Ratio not to fall below 1.75 x as of each fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2026 through and including December 31, 2026
Current Ratio not to fall below 1.00 x, determined as of the last day of any fiscal quarter commencing with the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2026
Liquidity not to fall below the greater of (x) $ 10,000,000 and (y) the amount equal to the scheduled principal and interest payments for the immediately succeeding three-month period

parsed.notes: No actual ratio values are disclosed; the filing only states the company was in compliance with all financial covenants under the 2026 Term Loan Agreement at September 30, 2026. The liquidity floor is the greater of $10.0 million and the next three months' scheduled principal and interest, so $10.0 million is only the minimum of that floor. The 2024 Amended Term Loan Agreement (as amended by the Second Amendment) had a Total Net Leverage covenant schedule, including 3.50x for Q3 2026, and a 1.85x Asset Coverage Ratio. Those limits appear to have been superseded by the 2026 Term Loan Agreement, so they are excluded. The leverage-based pricing grid sets only the interest margin and is also excluded.
